title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.3.5510
body_markdown:
* Add support for more languages for completions
* Show chat progress when processing messages
* Expose editor networking via settings. This can be used e.g. when facing HTTP(S) proxy issues.
* Fix issues when cancelling chat messages
* Fix invalid thread access when performing some network requests
* Several prompt improvements
